name: Brewferm Brewer 30 L
notes: 30 L total, 25 L to the max line; ~20 L batches. Estimated (no manufacturer figure) -- calibrate on your own system: loss 1.5 L, boil-off 3 L/h. Mash: Unlike the other systems in this file, there is no malt pipe or pump: the Brewer is an electric kettle with thermostat, used brew-in-a-bag (Brewferm sells a false bottom for this). The drained wort stays in the kettle; grain absorption is lower (~0.66 L/kg) if you squeeze the bag.
source_names: DotBeer example library via Brewtarget DefaultContent005

name: Grainfather G30 (v3)
notes: Max pre-boil 30 L; batch 10-25 L. Loss (2 L, trub + chiller) and boil-off (3 L/h at 230 V, ~2 L/h at 120 V) are Grainfather's own example figures. Mash: foundation_volume is Grainfather's figure for the space below the basket. Grain bill 1.5-8 kg (9 kg with top plate extension). Grainfather uses 0.8 L/kg grain absorption and 2.7 L/kg mash thickness.
source_names: DotBeer example library via Brewtarget DefaultContent005

name: Grainfather G40
notes: Max pre-boil 46 L; batch 10-40 L. Weight 29 kg empty. Estimated (no manufacturer figure) -- calibrate on your own system: loss 2.5 L, boil-off 4 L/h, internal diameter ~53 cm (from 555 mm overall width). Mash: Dished centre drain means essentially no volume below the plate (per Grainfather), hence foundation_volume of 0. Grain bill 3-13 kg. default_batch_size is 39.5 L rather than the manufacturer's 40 L, as 40 L plus a 60 minute boil-off (4 L) and kettle loss (2.5 L) would not fit in the 46 L kettle.
source_names: DotBeer example library via Brewtarget DefaultContent005
